name: Balancer V2
rootCause: On September 20th, the DeFi liquidity protocol Balancer fell victim to a DNS hijacking attack. Funds have been directed to an address starting with 0x6457, resulting in a total loss of approximately $350,000. The attacker’s fee came from the phishing group AngelDrainer. The attacker may be related to Russia.

descriptions.text: On September 20th, the DeFi liquidity protocol Balancer fell victim to a DNS hijacking attack. Funds have been directed to an address starting with 0x6457, resulting in a total loss of approximately $350,000. The attacker’s fee came from the phishing group AngelDrainer. The attacker may be related to Russia.

Balancer V2’s web frontend was compromised on Ethereum on September 19, 2023. Users connecting to the site were prompted to approve malicious contract transactions, resulting in around $238,000 in losses. Balancer’s web frontend (balancer.fi) was compromised via a DNS hijack or similar infrastructure attack. Users interacting with the site were redirected to a malicious interface, where they unknowingly approved fraudulent wallet-draining transactions.
